result.title: OVET-Consensus: Rank-Preserving Counterfactual Event Verification for Video Moment Grounding
result.summary: Modern video moment retrieval systems often propose windows that overlap the target event, yet still select the wrong one. We study this scorer bottleneck on QVHighlights with a fixed QD-DETR-derived temporal expert: the parent-aware temporal expert reaches 64.71 R1@0.5, while diagnostic oracles over the same candidate family reach 75.68 R1@0.5 within the parent-reranked pool and 94.97 R1@0.5 over the full 100-candidate evidence pool. We introduce OVET-Consensus, a rank-preserving counterfactual event verification layer that keeps the temporal expert's ranked list as the default and permits only high-confidence rank-1 overrides from a policy calibrated on held-out training videos. The verifier uses parent-aware interval evidence, structured Qwen3-VL event judgments, VideoLLaMA3 pairwise temporal signals, and dense temporal evidence, but never lets those signals freely reorder the top-K list. On QVHighlights validation, OVET-Consensus improves the parent-aware temporal expert from 64.71 to 65.35 R1@0.5 with a positive paired-bootstrap interval, while mAP is largely unchanged, from 42.67 to 42.74; it makes 20 overrides, with 15 helpful corrections and 3 harmful corrections. The results point to a practical constraint on verifier design: semantic compatibility is useful evidence, but temporal grounding still requires deciding where the event starts, changes, and ends inside a visually compatible scene.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 QVHighlights 上以固定 QD-DETR 时序专家为基座，用 oracle 诊断「候选窗口重叠目标却排序错误」的评分瓶颈，并提出保序的反事实事件校验层 OVET-Consensus：融合 Qwen3-VL 结构化事件判断、VideoLLaMA3 成对时序信号与稠密时序证据，仅允许高置信度 top-1 覆盖，R1@0.5 由 64.71 升至 65.35。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对多模态校验信号只做受限覆盖、且「语义兼容不足以确定事件起止与转折」的诊断，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与候选/停止决策是否真正被利用，但任务属视频时刻检索，与推理期 latent 状态生成仍有距离。
